drivers.notes: AVer's published 'VISCA over IP' protocol guide uses UDP 52381 with the Sony 8-byte header (verified against AVer's Pro-AV control codes PDF). A dedicated AVer driver would add their HTTP /ptz/getstatus query, picture profile presets, and product-specific extensions -- not yet shipped.

Sony's VISCA-over-IP wire format is the de-facto cross-vendor standard for pro PTZ cameras. Brand-specific drivers expose more (vendor-specific image presets, preset-name strings, OSD/menu, lens controls) and should be preferred when available.

The full RoboSHOT family shares one Telnet API. Vaddio is now part of Legrand AV — older boxes still ship as "Vaddio". ConferenceShot models predate the rename and use an older firmware revision but the same command shape. Speed ranges (pan 1-24, tilt 1-20, zoom 1-7, focus 1-8) and CCU value ranges are consistent across the family.
